outcome: neonatal outcome (umbilical artery pH, Apgar score, neonatal complications)
finding: Monochorionic and dichorionic twin pregnancies had similar rates of cesarean section and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found no difference in mode of delivery or neonatal outcomes between monochorionic and dichorionic twin pregnancies, suggesting that vaginal birth could be offered regardless of chorionicity.
birth_weight: lower in monochorionic twins (2249 ± 469 g vs. 2329 ± 478 g, p = 0.045)
